entries.name: shadcn/ui
entries.summary: Accessible React components copied into the project as source code
entries.rule:
Add components with the shadcn CLI's `add` command, run through the project's package manager, instead of writing them from scratch.
Before creating a primitive such as a button or dialog, check the ui folder set in `components.json`; the components there are project code you may edit.
entries.why: Reusing the same components keeps styling and accessibility consistent across the app.
